ownRead.title: Random-light interactions
ownRead.description: Artificially generated random light produces measured attractive interactions between dielectric microspheres.
ownRead.statement:
## E19 — Controlling dispersion forces between small particles with artificially created random light fields

**experiment and theory · partial bridge · claims C0, C4.**

**Reported result:** Artificially generated random light produces measured attractive interactions between dielectric microspheres.

**Already supplied:** Pre-existing spheres and a laser-generated, quasi-monochromatic random optical field are provided.

**Limit of the RRG connection:** Random does not mean broadband white noise. The experiment supports fluctuation-mediated interaction, not spontaneous creation of the spheres; broader interaction designs include theoretical proposals.

**Source:** Brügger, Froufe-Pérez, Scheffold & Sáenz (2015), *Nature Communications 6, 7460*. [DOI: 10.1038/ncomms8460](https://doi.org/10.1038/ncomms8460).

**Verification coverage:** Publisher HTML, including experimental versus theoretical scope. Checked 2026-10-02.
